direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow:hidden at 1366x768; rows 48px header / 40px compact horizontal rail / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; main uses independent reserved zones with no overlap: rendered scene at least 70% of main, plus fixed callout, station and job tracks; single non-wrapping horizontal rail of 9 equal step targets with aria-current and arrow-key movement; refit tight zones before reducing type; condense or paginate side content inside its reserved zone; all targets at least 36px
direction.colorTokens: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, border rgba(197,204,212,.22); brushed silver #C5CCD4 for headings and machine bodies, silverDim rgba(197,204,212,.68); emerald/neon #A8F04A primary with #050705 text, one primary per viewport; stoppedRed #E5484D reserved exclusively for stopped CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text; official logo immutable black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story, never recolored, cropped, redrawn or duplicated elsewhere
direction.typography: System sans; 16px/24 body minimum, 24/30 stage title, 18/24 panel title, 12/16 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration; enlarge any label under 12px to 12px minimum
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out for selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on real state change, then static; no loops or pulses; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while pattern, marker and text still carry meaning; 2px neon focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries the second and final logo placement; compact horizontal rail from one steps array; guide line inside rail zone with no duplicate primary; focusable cinematic factory SVG as dominant scene; side zone keeps pre-flight route-health checks for nonce and identity visually and semantically separate from the distinct investigation evidence task, with separate headings, status and controls; action bar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; skip-to-stage first, then header, rail, SVG nodes, side zone and action bar in tab order; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite announces results only
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 SVG enlarged to fill at least 70% of main, using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in neon, silver for idle machines, red only for stopped CELL-MILL-2, never a route through the offline cell; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap inside stage bounds; bidirectional SVG-to-side-zone highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline-Stopped/Feasible-Accepted legend using pattern, marker and text; pending task proposals deliberately untracked until human approval, while blocked prior tasks remain visible beside an approved recovery plan as replacement tasks await approval

fixes.change: Remove the extra logo inside the scene panel; retain only the header logo here and the second placement in the opening story.
Enlarge the factory SVG to at least 70% of main and shrink the right evidence zone to its fixed track so stations, jobs and Certificate/Receiving tracks stay inside scene bounds.
Raise sub-16px source-detail and metric labels to 16px body or 12px micro-label minimum and give the primary Inspect source evidence a visible focus ring.

Keep Route health pre-flight for nonce and identity as a separate headed group from Investigation source evidence, each with its own status and control, as currently separated; preserve that separation when refitting.
Enlarge the scene toward 70% fill by widening station and job nodes and reducing empty grid area below JOB-1002.
Raise the offline-sample explanatory text to 16px/24 and ensure the route select and Run Sample investigation are at least 36px with a 2px focus ring.
Do not treat the pre-selection view as missing consent: on selecting any of the three paths, open the typed consent form and move focus into it with Esc to close.
Enlarge the SVG scene to 70% fill; the large empty Human Decision panel should be condensed inside its reserved zone rather than displacing the scene.
Make each Select this path control at least 36px, keyboard reachable in SVG-to-side-zone order, with selected state shown by marker and text as well as neon outline.
Restore a visible factory scene presence: shrink the oversized t1 proposal card so station and job zones remain independently reserved and the scene does not become only task cards.
Keep the 3 proposed tasks clearly labelled untracked until approval, distinct from tracked work, and raise small due/after text to 16px.
Condense the duplicated proposal detail in the right zone into its fixed track so Approve and Decline remain visible without crowding the action bar.
In preview keep CELL-MILL-2 silver dashed as shown; on Apply switch only that station to stoppedRed outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text, with no route through it.
Enlarge route traces between RECEIVING, CELL-MILL-1, JOB-1001 and JOB-1002 to fill more of the scene and reduce empty lower grid.
Raise preview micro-labels to 12px minimum and give Apply second shock a clear invalidating-action warning linked to the action-bar status.
Preserve red exclusively on stopped CELL-MILL-2 and remove red emphasis from RECEIVING HOLD so the stopped exception stays unambiguous; use held pattern and text for MAT-ALLOY-A.
Keep nonce/identity pre-flight separate from the investigation evidence task and show that Split is constrained because no feasible route uses the offline cell.
Enlarge the scene toward 70% and raise the constrained option label to 16px with pattern plus text, not colour alone.
On selecting a feasible revised path, open the typed consent form before acceptance; keep Review revised option disabled or clearly pending until a path is chosen.
Preserve red only on CELL-MILL-2, show Split constrained with hatch, marker and reason text, and never draw a route through that cell.
Condense the empty Human Decision area inside its reserved zone and enlarge station and job nodes to increase scene fill.
Keep 3 blocked prior tasks visibly separate from the 3 proposed replacements awaiting approval beside the approved revised plan; do not merge their counts or statuses.
Shrink the oversized t1 card and restore balanced station and job zone proportions so the left scene reads as work state, not a single panel.
Raise small owner and due text to 16px and ensure task number targets 1-3 are at least 36px with arrow-key and focus-ring support.
Keep Verify, Seal and Retain as sequential gated stages with locked states carried by text and marker, and keep the passphrase field separate from the ledger control.
Enlarge the three stage cards to use more scene height while keeping the right evidence zone in its fixed track at 1366x768.
Raise checklist and passphrase guidance to 16px/24 and add aria-live polite announcement only when verification changes state.
Align the rail and heading with the 9-step story: label this as completion after Step 9 of 9 rather than implying an extra guided step, while keeping Complete marked current.
Keep all three sealed stages equal in emphasis with check, pattern and SEALED text, and retain CELL-MILL-2 offline status in the final status line.
Ensure Back remains the only action-bar control here with no duplicate primary, and give Export independent checkpoint a 2px focus ring and at least 36px height.
